title: JavaScript: Understanding the Weird Parts - The First 3.5 Hours
summary: The first 3.5 hours of Tony Alicea's Udemy course on JavaScript's inner workings, covering topics such as first-class functions, closures, prototypal inheritance and how the language behaves under the hood.
why: HN commenters call it one of the best JavaScript courses: rigorous and deep but not boring, and freely available.

quote.text: they are the holy grails of online education for me. Rigorous -- but not boring or too long.
